name: Scrap Metal
desc: Raw salvageable metal from the junkyard.
flavor: One man's trash is another man's mecha.

name: Energy
desc: Your physical stamina. Regenerates over time.
flavor: Rest is a weapon. Use it wisely.

name: Nano Infra
desc: Nanoscale infrastructure material. Refined from raw scrap.

name: Armor Plating
flavor: When the streets fight back, you'll want this.

name: Nanofiber Fabric
desc: Ultra-light woven nanofiber. Used in flexible armor and conduits.
flavor: Stronger than steel, lighter than silk.

name: Mecha Parts
desc: Salvaged components usable in mecha assembly.
flavor: Every bolt counts when you're building a giant.

name: Data Chips
desc: Encrypted data fragments. Used for research and hacking.
flavor: Knowledge is power — and power is expensive.

name: Space
desc: Available area in your scrapyard sector.
flavor: Floor space is at a premium in New Tokyo.
